name: recorded-companies-query-ok
description: RECORDED against production 2026-10-10 with `deno task record`, then hand-minimized per fixture strategy v2. Headers are never captured, so no credential can be in here. A narrow filter (30M+ LinkedIn followers) that matches only three companies: an EXACT integer total and a null cursor, which is how a caller knows to stop. The third ID is restored from the same live response, which the recorder's array cap had dropped, so the payload is internally consistent at total 3.
